answer: A farm running 53 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. Because the reef stake is held until the karst settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the vertex audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 19% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
